name: Oyokal
description: Oyokal was a terrestrial planet located in the Oyokal system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Shihon system. A quadrupedal species was native to Oyokal.
lead_paragraphs: Oyokal was a terrestrial planet located in the Oyokal system of the Unknown Regions' Chiss Space. A hyperlane linked the world to the Shihon system. A quadrupedal species was native to Oyokal.
The sentient Chiss of the Chiss Ascendancy maintained Oyokal as an aquaculture colony. The planet's surface featured wave-riding algal beds and pools stocked with fish.
